newsitem.title: HONG KONG: WI Carr names three new senior executives in Asia.
newsitem.headline: WI Carr names three new senior executives in Asia.

text.p: W.I. Carr said on Friday it had named David Williamson as head of sales in its Hong Kong office. Williamson was sales director at UBS Securities in Hong Kong.

The stockbroker also said Stephen Hill will move to Bangkok as managing director of W.I. Carr Far East Ltd, with responsibility for Thailand, effective November 25. Hill was managing director of institutional equity, Asia and Japan, for Bear Stearns Asia in Hong Kong.

Brian Brown was appointed managing director, head of global sales, for the Indian sub-continent and will be based in Hong Kong, it said. Brown joins W.I. Carr from Merrill Lynch, where he was director and head of Indian sales.
W.I. Carr is the stockbroking arm of Banque Indosuez.
